title: Yo Is Emphasis In Practice (15s micro-cut)
voice_notes: Remix variant - reuses lesson-17-yo-emphasis audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: Do not say yo every time English says I.
Use yo when you want to stress who is doing it: I want it, not someone else.
segments.show:
I want it
not someone else

segments.say: Say I want, with that me, not them feeling.
Use yo when you are contrasting, correcting, or making your own choice clear.

caption: Spanish usually drops 'I'. Use yo only to stress it: yo quiero.
